own_solution.law: T = 2 pi sqrt(r^3/(g R^2)), r = R + h
assumptions: circular orbit, no drag, no other bodies
satellite mass negligible relative to Earth

notes: Strata and answers agree with pass 1. Verified R answers: r = 7071 km -> T = 5923.5 s = 98.726 min; r = 7171 km -> 109.38 min; r = 8171 km -> T = 7358.2 s = 122.637 min. Satellite mass cancels (C). Minimal pairs T4F19/TDE51 (station vs satellite, 'then raised by 800 km') and TF747/T2454 (earlier mission vs before period measured, 800 km) differ only in attachment/timing. Numeral-free controls by design. The outset clause makes the 'earlier mission' sentence unambiguously D.
